selection_rule: Twelve computer-science/AI topics, three per registered maturity category, selected before confirmatory generation and disjoint from both pilot topics.
retrieval_gate: Each topic must yield at least 30 pre-cutoff candidates for every primary system before generation.

topics.title: Neural Machine Translation
topics.scope: Neural methods for machine translation, from recurrent encoder-decoder and attention models through Transformer systems, multilingual and low-resource translation, training objectives, decoding, evaluation, robustness, and documented limitations. Exclude rule-based and statistical machine translation except as historical context.

topics.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning
topics.scope: Deep neural approaches to reinforcement learning, including value-based and policy-gradient methods, actor-critic architectures, model-based learning, exploration, offline reinforcement learning, multi-agent settings, generalization, safety, and evaluation. The review should focus on algorithmic developments rather than application catalogues alone.

topics.title: Adversarial Robustness of Deep Neural Networks
topics.scope: Adversarial examples and robustness in deep neural networks, covering threat models, attacks, adversarial training, certified defenses, robustness evaluation, distribution shift connections, adaptive attack methodology, and persistent limitations. General cybersecurity work without a learned-model robustness component is out of scope.

topics.title: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
topics.scope: Diffusion-based text-to-image generation through the end of 2023, including latent diffusion, text conditioning, guidance, controllability, personalization, efficient sampling, evaluation, dataset and safety issues, and comparison with earlier generative paradigms. Non-visual diffusion applications are secondary.

topics.title: Vision-Language Pretraining
topics.scope: Pretrained models that jointly learn from images and natural language, including contrastive, generative, and alignment objectives; architectures and datasets; zero-shot transfer; grounding; adaptation; evaluation; bias; and robustness through 2023. The focus is representation learning rather than general multimodal foundation-model commentary.

topics.title: Large Language Model Agents
topics.scope: Agent systems built around large language models through 2023, including planning, memory, tool use, reflection, multi-agent coordination, environment interaction, benchmarks, failure modes, and safety. Standard language-model prompting without persistent state, actions, or environment interaction is outside the core scope.

topics.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning
topics.scope: Self-supervised representation learning across major modalities, emphasizing pretext, contrastive, masked-prediction, redundancy-reduction, and teacher-student objectives; architecture and augmentation choices; transfer; scaling; evaluation; and collapse avoidance. Purely supervised pretraining is excluded.

topics.title: Continual Learning
topics.scope: Methods for learning from non-stationary task or data streams while limiting catastrophic forgetting, including replay, regularization, architectural, parameter-isolation, and dynamic approaches; task-, domain-, and class-incremental settings; evaluation protocols; transfer; memory constraints; and open-world extensions.

topics.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Deep Learning
topics.scope: Methods for representing, estimating, calibrating, and evaluating predictive uncertainty in deep learning, including Bayesian approximations, ensembles, evidential methods, conformal prediction interfaces, out-of-distribution uncertainty, calibration, and decision-making consequences. Generic interpretability without uncertainty estimation is excluded.

topics.title: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis
topics.scope: Deep-learning methods for medical image classification, detection, segmentation, registration, reconstruction, and report-related analysis across imaging modalities, with attention to supervision regimes, domain shift, evaluation, clinical validation, uncertainty, fairness, and deployment constraints.

topics.title: Machine Learning for Drug Discovery
topics.scope: Machine-learning methods across molecular representation, property and activity prediction, virtual screening, de novo molecular generation, synthesis planning, protein-ligand modeling, data and benchmark design, uncertainty, and experimental validation. Clinical outcome prediction without a drug-discovery component is outside scope.

topics.title: Efficient Deep Learning
topics.scope: Methods that reduce the computational, memory, energy, or latency costs of deep neural networks, including pruning, quantization, distillation, parameter-efficient architectures, efficient training and inference, hardware-aware design, measurement practice, and accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.
